tile_layout: non-overlapping 2x2 crops in row-major image position; each 512x512 crop produces a 32x32 patch grid; tiles are stitched to 64x64
prototype: L2-normalize each support token; area-average binary PV mask to 64x64 fractions; weighted sum support tokens by fractions; L2-normalize the sum
cam_formula: A_fg = (S_fg - min(S_fg)) / (max(S_fg) - min(S_fg) + 1e-8); constant maps are set to zero; bilinear upsample to 1024x1024 with align_corners=False
